name: Rolling team scoring-differential spread baseline
hypothesis: Compare a no-HFA rolling PF/G + opponent PA/G score projection to contemporaneous book spread; register direction and threshold before testing.
current_evidence: 2026 Week 10 baseline lines and Week 2-9 walk-forward accuracy are descriptive only.
required_missing: historical timestamped prices, closing prices, complete bet/settlement ledger, prospective holdout

name: Rolling offense/defense total baseline
hypothesis: Compare symmetric team scoring projections to two-book total consensus; calibrate uncertainty before any use.
current_evidence: Own baseline totals and two-book dated snapshot; no return/CLV evaluation.
required_missing: timestamped total prices, closing prices, settlement ledger, holdout calibration

name: Cross-game parlay probability model
hypothesis: Estimate joint outcome probability from game-level model probabilities and dependence; compare to exact offered parlay price after margin.
current_evidence: No joint outcome probabilities or wager ledger computed.
required_missing: timestamped multi-leg odds, event-level calibrated probabilities, historical joint outcomes, settlement rules

name: Same-game parlay dependence model
hypothesis: Estimate conditional same-game leg dependence from paired official game-level outcomes and compare to bookmaker price.
current_evidence: Correlation coefficients, joint rates and fair odds intentionally blank.
required_missing: paired player/game logs, exact prop lines and prices, settlement definitions, joint validation sample

name: Player-prop combo: passing + receiver production
hypothesis: Test paired QB passing and target receiver receiving outcomes, conditioned on starters, opponent and usage; do not multiply marginal probabilities unless independence is tested.
signal_fields: player-game passing/receiving paired residuals; exact prop line; joint outcome
current_evidence: Official 2026 aggregate player leaders pages exist; no canonical paired game-log extract or prop price ledger.
required_missing: official paired player game logs, as-of starter status, prop price history and settlements

name: Depth-chart-aware availability adjustment
hypothesis: Apply a pre-estimated position/player replacement-value coefficient only when a documented starter absence and active replacement are confirmed.
signal_fields: verified_inactive_starter; confirmed replacement; calibrated delta-EPA/score; uncertainty
current_evidence: 76 selected status/depth observations; no validated conversion from string slot to points.
required_missing: final active list, player-level snaps/production, replacement-level baseline, out-of-sample effect estimate
